# Piscinas Yuriy, S.L.

> Pool builder based in Pego (Alicante), Spain. Builds, renovates and services
> masonry (gunite) pools across the Comunitat Valenciana, from the Valencia area
> down to Alicante.

## Positioning
Pool construction is the core proposition. Technical installations (filtration,
water treatment, heating, electrical work, lighting) are named service blocks
inside that offer, executed by the company's own crew.

## Services (4 blocks)
- Construcción de piscinas — full masonry build: excavation, rebar, gunite,
  waterproofing, tiling.
- Reparación y renovación — leak repair, waterproofing, replacement of gresite
  or porcelain lining on existing pools.
- Fontanería, filtración y tratamiento del agua — hydraulic circuit, filters and
  pumps, salt chlorination, pH control.
- Climatización, electricidad e iluminación — heat pumps, pool electrical
  installation, electrical panels, pool lighting.

## Service area
Comunitat Valenciana, Valencia-to-Alicante corridor. Reference towns: Valencia,
Gandia, Oliva, Pego, Dénia, Ondara, El Verger, Xàbia, Benissa, Teulada-Moraira,
Calp, Altea, Benidorm, Alicante.

## Language
Site copy is Spanish (es-ES). Prices are in EUR and quoted per project after an
on-site visit; no price list is published.
